V1_us_orb30_wide.rule: BTCUSDT 5-min bars (proxy for CME MBT), times America/Chicago, Mon-Fri. Opening range OR = [min low, max high] of the 6 bars with open times 08:30 to 09:00 CT exclusive (complete range required); OR open = open of the 08:30 bar. Width filter: trade only if (OR high - OR low)/OR open >= the median of that quantity over the previous 60 weekdays with a complete OR (strictly prior days; at least 30 required, else no trade). From the 09:00 bar onwards, the FIRST 5-min close above OR high -> long, first close below OR low -> short (one trade per day, whichever happens first, no re-entry). Fill at the open of the next bar; the fill bar must open before 15:08 CT. Stop = the opposite side of the OR (OR low for longs, OR high for shorts), checked on bar highs/lows from the fill bar on, filled at the stop price. No target. Exit at the 15:08 CT deadline = the open of the 15:10 CT bar (forced flat); no weekend positions. Cost $3.82 per round turn.

V4_evening_orb60.rule: BTCUSDT 5-min bars (proxy for CME MBT), times America/Chicago. Sessions start 17:00 CT; only sessions starting Sunday-Thursday. Opening range OR = [min low, max high] of the 12 bars with open times 17:00 to 18:00 CT exclusive (complete range required). From the 18:00 CT bar until the 01:55 CT bar (signal bar open < 02:00 CT), the FIRST 5-min close above OR high -> long, first close below OR low -> short (one trade per session, whichever happens first, no re-entry). Fill at the open of the next bar. Stop = the opposite side of the OR (OR low for longs, OR high for shorts), checked on bar highs/lows from the fill bar on, filled at the stop price. No target. Exit at the 15:08 CT deadline the next day = the open of the 15:10 CT bar (forced flat). Cost $3.82 per round turn.
